pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygonal regions with variable edge gradients; edge sharpness is high in lower regions and reduced in dorsal areas due to textural anomalies. Patch size decreases towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform throughout the lower flank but appears compressed and visually obstructed by raised textures on the upper flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the upper neck, characterized by dark pixel tufts contrasting against the lighter background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Widespread, localized patches of extreme textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation on the upper flank and along the dorsal ridge, appearing as dark, raised, crusty masses.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of dark, raised, nodular protrusions and crusty textural anomalies across the dorsal-lateral surface, creating significant 3D relief on the hide.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and size of the dark, protruding nodular growths on the right flank are highly distinctive, obscuring the underlying pelage pattern in several focal points.
